Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Scofield
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/08/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 124 as introduced would allow units of government that provide broadband services to receive grants awarded by the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) from the Broadband Accessibility Grant program.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Scofield
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/09/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 124 as introduced, amended, and reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development would allow units of government that provide broadband services to receive grants awarded by the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) from the Broadband Accessibility Grant program.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Urban and Rural Development
Sponsor: Scofield
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 124 as passed the Senate revises the Broadband Accessibility Grant program administered by the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) by: (1) allowing units of government that provide broadband services to be awarded grants; (2) increasing the cap on individual awards under this program; (3) raising the minimum service threshold for the program; (4) providing additional priority criteria for awarding grants; (5) revising application and project timelines; and (6) further providing for conditions of release of funds under this program.
Randall Shedd, Chair
Urban and Rural Development
